description: Create a plugin-level MCP server on the installed plugin: `command`, `args` and `env` for "stdio", `url` and `headers` for "http"/"sse" (the other transport's fields are ignored). Values may reference environment variables as ${VAR}. Then regenerates the installed plugin locally, like `athenode init` without confirmation (the result adds `install` and `regeneration`, whose `pluginChanges` lists the tools whose plugin package or declaration was rewritten, with `suppressedIn` naming another tool's local settings file the plugin was switched off in; `missingEnvVars` is checked against the MCP server's environment, not your shell). If regeneration fails, the backend change is still saved and the tool returns an error. Requires an installed plugin (`npx @athenode/cli init`), unless `pluginId` names another plugin of the project: that one is changed on the server only, with no local regeneration.

args.description: Arguments of the command (stdio; CLI: --arg, repeatable).

pluginId.description: Id of the plugin to act on (see plugins_list); the installed plugin if omitted (CLI: --plugin-id).
